holidays.name: National Cat Day
holidays.description: A day for cat lovers to celebrate their feline overlords with treats, extra cuddles, and an unreasonable number of photos. It also encourages adopting cats from shelters.
holidays.origin: Founded in 2005 by Colleen Paige, a pet and family lifestyle expert, to raise awareness of cats in need of homes and to encourage people to save lives by adopting.
holidays.funFact: Cats sleep roughly 12 to 16 hours a day, so the average cat will spend about two-thirds of its life napping, and National Cat Day mostly respects that schedule.

holidays.name: National Oatmeal Day
holidays.description: A cozy celebration of the humble breakfast bowl, topped with everything from brown sugar and berries to bacon and peanut butter.
holidays.origin: An unofficial food holiday that grew out of the popularity of oats as a healthy, budget-friendly breakfast, and it falls at the perfect time of year for warm bowls as the weather turns chilly.
holidays.funFact: Oats were originally considered weeds growing among wheat and barley crops, and they were only later cultivated as a food crop in their own right.

holidays.name: Internet Day
holidays.description: A tribute to the web that lets us watch cat videos, argue with strangers, and look up how to do everything. It marks the moment the internet first said hello.
holidays.origin: On October 29, 1969, the first message was sent over ARPANET, the precursor to the modern internet, from UCLA to the Stanford Research Institute.
holidays.funFact: The very first message was meant to be the word LOGIN, but the system crashed after the first two letters, so the internet's first message was just LO, as in lo and behold.

holidays.name: Hermit Day
holidays.description: A day for introverts and homebodies to lock the door, silence the phone, and happily cancel plans without any guilt.
holidays.origin: An unofficial observance celebrated by people who prefer solitude, and its timing near Halloween season suits those who would rather hand out candy through a cracked door.
holidays.funFact: Hermit crabs are not true hermits at all, since they often live in large social groups and will line up by size to swap shells in a so-called vacancy chain.

holidays.name: Awkward Moments Day
holidays.description: A day to embrace every cringeworthy slip, stumble, and social blunder, and to laugh at yourself instead of replaying them at 3 a.m.
holidays.origin: A lighthearted unofficial observance that encourages people to share their most embarrassing stories and to treat awkwardness as a universal human experience.
holidays.funFact: Psychologists call the feeling that everyone notices your embarrassing moments the spotlight effect, and research shows people notice far less than you think.
